visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Sorted in the Wrong Direction
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The array should be sorted into ascending order 1 5 7 8 9 10, but it comes out descending.

solution.explanation: Partition moves the elements that belong on the left of the pivot to the front. For ascending order those are the smaller ones (< pivot). Testing > pivot collects the larger elements on the left and produces descending order.
